decisions.evidence: ABZR86_RS08705 is annotated 'acetylglutamate kinase' (ArgB, EC 2.7.2.8), exactly this reaction; supported by its arg cluster with argC RS08700, argE RS08710, argG RS08715, argH RS08695 and N-acetylornithine carbamoyltransferase RS08730.

Small subunit RS15930 is already AND-paired with each large subunit; RS07005 'acetolactate synthase large subunit' is a same-name paralog of ilv-cluster RS15935, so R1 is barred and no unjoined subunits remain for R2.

RS17400 is the specific acetylornithine transaminase, but RS09395 'aminotransferase class III-fold PLP-dependent enzyme' is a family-level aminotransferase compatible with the reaction and must not be removed.
ABZR86_RS08700 is annotated 'N-acetyl-gamma-glutamyl-phosphate reductase' (ArgC, EC 1.2.1.38, matching the reaction EC); supported by adjacency to acetylglutamate kinase RS08705 in the arg cluster.
Outer-membrane diffusion step (extracellular to periplasm) through non-specific porins; diffusion steps are not assigned.

RS12070 is the specific 'anthranilate phosphoribosyltransferase' (TrpD, EC 2.4.2.18) in the trpC-trpD-trpG cluster; RS14265 'anthranilate synthase family protein' (620 aa TrpE/G-like chorismate-aminating enzyme in a phenazine-like cluster with PhzF, isochorismatase and class II DAHP synthase) has a different activity and is removed.
TrpE RS12180 and TrpG RS12075 are already joined with AND; RS14265 'anthranilate synthase family protein' carries a family-level annotation compatible with this reaction, so it cannot be removed.

RS19560 'bifunctional aspartate kinase/diaminopimelate decarboxylase' (871 aa) is the only annotated aspartate kinase; RS15985 and RS19035 are monofunctional 'homoserine dehydrogenase' (355/363 aa, EC 1.1.1.3, no ThrA/MetL kinase domain) with a different activity and are removed.
All six alternatives are generic PLP aminotransferases (RS20415 is a MocR-like PdxR regulator per RefSeq, but the genes that would remain all carry generic annotations, so R1 is barred).
Both genes are glycoside hydrolase family 3 proteins (RS15485 RefSeq 'beta-glucosidase family protein'), family-level annotations compatible with cellobiose hydrolysis.
No gene is annotated as a cellobiose-specific transporter; only generic 'sugar porter family MFS transporter' and ABC transporter genes exist.

No specific copper importer is annotated: only a 149-aa 'CopD family protein' (RS09705, family-level, uptake role unproven), periplasmic/outer-membrane copper resistance proteins (CopA/CopB) and CDF/P-type ATPase efflux systems.

RS12130 and RS19560 are specific DAP decarboxylases, but RS03475 'type III PLP-dependent enzyme' is a family-level (fold-type III decarboxylase) annotation compatible with the reaction and cannot be removed.
All three genes are annotated 3-deoxy-7-phosphoheptulonate synthase (same-name paralogs).

RS02735 '4a-hydroxytetrahydrobiopterin dehydratase' (114 aa pterin-4a-carbinolamine dehydratase, EC 4.2.1.96) acts on a different substrate class and is removed; RS15945 'dihydroxy-acid dehydratase' (ilv cluster) and RS04080 'IlvD/Edd family dehydratase' are kept.
Both genes are '4-hydroxy-tetrahydrodipicolinate reductase' (same-name paralogs).
RS00785 is the specific DapA; RS20490 'dihydrodipicolinate synthase family protein' is a family-level annotation compatible with the reaction.
RS08760 is the specific dihydroorotase; RS08310 and WP_035322884_1 are 'amidohydrolase family protein' (family-level, same superfamily as dihydroorotase), so they are not removable.
RS05565 is '30S ribosomal protein S1' (558 aa, canonical cmk-rpsA-ihfB context), a ribosomal protein and not a catalyst; RS00985 '4-hydroxy-3-methylbut-2-enyl diphosphate reductase' (IspH) remains.
Outer-membrane diffusion step (extracellular to periplasm) through non-specific porins; diffusion steps are not assigned.
Both genes are fumarate hydratases (RS05855 class II, RS19555 'fumarate hydratase'): same-name paralogs.
Both alternatives are sugar:H+ MFS transporters of the right substrate class (RS11100 FucP-family 'L-fucose:H+ symporter permease', RS01200 'sugar porter family MFS transporter').
RS19860 is the specific PurN (adjacent to PurM); RS19345 'formyl transferase' is a family-level annotation compatible with a formyltransferase reaction, so it is not removable.

RS18710 is the specific GlmS; RS16050 'SIS domain-containing protein' (345 aa, likely lacking the glutaminase domain) is a family-level annotation sharing GlmS's isomerase domain, so it is not removed under the procedure.
Both genes are 'homoserine dehydrogenase' (same-name paralogs).

All eight alternatives are generic or broad-specificity aminotransferases (BCATs, PLP aminotransferases); RS03710 is a MocR-like regulator per RefSeq, but the remaining genes all carry generic annotations, so R1 is barred.
Both genes are 'ribose-phosphate diphosphokinase' (same-name paralogs).

Thioredoxin TrxA (RS12605) is the reductant substrate, not the catalyst, and RS17090 'TlpA disulfide reductase/peroxiredoxin family protein' is a thiol-disulfide oxidoreductase; both are removed. Class II RNR NrdJ (RS17550) and the class I NrdA/NrdB complex (RS16265 and RS16255) are kept.

No gene is annotated as phosphoserine:homoserine phosphotransferase (ThrH) or phosphoserine phosphatase; only generic HAD hydrolases (e.g. RS09400 'MtnX-like HAD-IB family phosphatase'). Homoserine kinase RS15980 is the ATP-dependent ThrB, a different reaction.
All five alternatives are generic PLP aminotransferases; with only generic annotations no removal is allowed.
RS15435 is the specific UppP/BacA; RS07930 'phosphatase PAP2 family protein' is a family-level phosphatase (the PAP2 family includes undecaprenyl-diphosphate phosphatases), so it is not removable.
Both genes are 'NAD-dependent epimerase/dehydratase family protein' (family-level; GalE belongs to this family).

RS21595 is the specific 'UMP kinase' (PyrH, EC 2.7.4.22, in the rpsB-tsf-pyrH-frr cluster); RS05570 '(d)CMP kinase' (Cmk, EC 2.7.4.25, cytidylate-specific NMP kinase) has a different specific activity and is removed.
No zinc-specific uptake transporter (ZupT/ZIP, ZnuABC) is annotated; only Nramp 'divalent metal transporter', CorA (Mg/Co), CDF and P-type ATPase efflux proteins.
